title: Grizzly Sport Fishing

services.name: Fishing Info
services.desc: After one of the nicest starts to October mother nature has changed things this week. Usually a good northeast blow like we are experiencing this week helps the fishing. Trigger fishing was good prior to the blow and the tog have begun to bite. Tog fishing should be good when we can get back fishing and should remain strong thru December. Striper fishing will begin by end of October and we will fish for them thru end of December as well. We have some weekend dates left in December along with a fair amount of weekdays the rest of the season.
